reviews.comment: Mr. Davies was one of my favorite professors this semester! He's funny and is passionate about the content. Classes were laid back with activities that kept me engaged. Assignments consisted of tutoring, reading, videos, and some discussions. Even though I may not become a teacher, I still found this class valuable and worthwhile. Highly recommend!

Very funny, caring, and was clearly passionate about the subject of teaching. Grades consisted of attendance, various assignments, and tutoring via zoom, not too much work. If youre on the fence about doing the SEED minor, take this class and meet with Davies as those both helped me make my decision. Overall, Davies is pretty Coolio (he's a rapper)

Highly recommend taking ARSC201 if you are planning to do the SEED minor. The tutoring is very helpful in learning if you'd enjoy teaching or not. Professor Davies is great as well, very funny and nice and accesible in and out of class for questions about aggieTEACH.
